groups.title: HTML
groups.summary: Render HTML, MHTML and ZIP site bundles to PDF or to page images.

subcommands.name: convert
subcommands.summary: Render an HTML page, MHTML archive or ZIP site bundle to PDF.

usage: officeimo html render <input.html|input.mhtml|input.zip|-> [--input-format html|mhtml|site-bundle] [--output <archive.zip|->] [--profile screen-viewport|screen-full-page|print-paged|screen-media-paged|screen-snapshot-paged|continuous-vector] [--encoder png|svg] [--pages all|<page>|<first-last>|stitched] [--viewport-width <css-px>] [--viewport-height <css-px>] [--scale <factor>] [--stylesheet <file.css>] [--base-uri <absolute-uri>] [--font-family <name> --font-regular <file.ttf>] [--font-bold <file.ttf>] [--font-italic <file.ttf>] [--font-bold-italic <file.ttf>] [--max-input-bytes <bytes>] [--max-pages <count>] [--max-archive-bytes <bytes>] [--entry-path <archive-path>] [--max-bundle-entry-bytes <bytes>] [--max-bundle-decoded-bytes <bytes>] [--max-bundle-entries <count>] [--max-manifest-bytes <bytes>] [--force]

keyOptions.name: --pdf-ua-language

groups.title: Workflow
groups.summary: Batch conversion with checkpoints, saved jobs, page images, assembly, comparison, print plans and printing.

subcommands.name: compare
subcommands.summary: Compare two PDFs and write an HTML difference report.

subcommands.name: optimize-images
subcommands.summary: Analyze or reduce the images in Word documents.
usage: officeimo workflow optimize-images <input.docx|input.doc>... [--analyze] [--output <file> | --output-directory <folder>] [--output-format docx|doc|pdf] [--mode downsample|recompress|both] [--dpi <36-1200>] [--quality <1-100>] [--force] [--format json|text]

usage: officeimo workflow print-plan <input.pdf> [--pages <selection>] [--paper A4|Letter|Legal|A3] [--password-env <name>] [--orientation auto|portrait|landscape] [--pages-per-sheet 1|2|4|6|9] [--scale fit|actual|fill|custom] [--custom-scale <percent>] [--margin <points>] [--margin-left <points>] [--margin-top <points>] [--margin-right <points>] [--margin-bottom <points>] [--alignment center|top-left|top|top-right|left|right|bottom-left|bottom|bottom-right] [--page-subset all|odd|even] [--color color|grayscale] [--format json|text]

exitCodes.name: ValidationFailed
exitCodes.meaning: The requested validation ran and found errors, for example invoice validate, markup validate or provenance check.

exitCodes.name: Usage
exitCodes.meaning: The command or an option is invalid, including a conversion with no matching route.

exitCodes.name: InputNotFound
exitCodes.meaning: An input file or folder was not found.

exitCodes.name: UnsupportedInput
exitCodes.meaning: The input is unsupported or could not be read.

exitCodes.name: OperationFailed
exitCodes.meaning: The document operation failed, including batches with failed items.

exitCodes.name: OutputFailed
exitCodes.meaning: The output could not be written, including a refused overwrite or an output over its size limit.
